records.title: The gateway now enforces the PQ rule in production, but no model has passed PQ, so production AI drafting is refused
records.evidenceAtHead: ENFORCEMENT (closed): server/services/ai-gateway/model-governance.ts:78-86 selectionRefusal returns 'pq-not-passed' for production document_drafting; gateway.ts:3292-3295 (explicit path) and :3312-3316 (strategy path) throw governanceError -> NO_PQ_QUALIFIED_MODEL (model-governance.ts:54-55, gateway.ts:4471). approved-models.ts:382-386 isQualifiedForHighRiskDrafting = approvedForHighRisk && (!production || pq.status==='passed'); AnA governed writes are gated by the same rule at server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts:507 (isServedModelApprovedForHighRisk). There is no env bypass: isProductionEnv is NODE_ENV only (pii-screen.ts:57-59). Command run at HEAD: tsx script calling selectionRefusal(claude-opus-4 / claude-opus-5-5) printed 'prod drafting pq-not-passed', 'dev drafting null', 'prod review null', 'passed entries: 0 of 16'. STILL OPEN: all 16 APPROVED_MODELS entries have pq {status:'pending', reference:null} (approved-models.ts:89,101,...,274). server/eval/pq/pq-protocol.json:6-8 status 'draft', approvedBy null, approvedOn null, so pq-verdict cannot produce PASS. run-pq.ts:26-29 says it measures the harness's own generation prompt and does not re-qualify production drafting prompts. Every deployment path runs NODE_ENV=production (terraform/modules/ecs-fargate/main.tf:153,296; docker-compose.yml:87; docker-compose.beta.yml:82), so document_drafting callers are refused there. These include server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts, server/services/authoring/section-generation-service.ts, ib-builder.ts, server/mcp/tools/drafting.ts and 23 other files (grep: 38 call sites). Stale comments at server/services/ai-gateway/effort.ts:156 and :207 still say the PQ clause is 'enforced nowhere yet'.
records.fixedBy: e2258d07a (2026-09-29): server/services/ai-gateway/model-governance.ts:78-86, 157-189; server/services/ai-governance/approved-models.ts:382-386, 413-419; wired at server/services/ai-gateway/gateway.ts:3292-3316; AnA governed-write gate server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts:507
records.remaining: (1) No model has a passed PQ. The protocol PQ-DRAFT-001 is still a draft with no approver, so no run can pass. (2) As a result, every NODE_ENV=production environment (AWS ECS staging and production, docker-compose, beta) refuses all document_drafting requests (Authoring editor AI actions, section generation, IB/CSR builders, MCP drafting tool) and all AnA governed content writes with 'No performance-qualified model is available for high-risk regulatory drafting in this environment.' (3) PQ scores the harness prompt, not the production drafting prompts, so a pass would not cover the prompts users actually run. (4) Callers that draft governed text under task labels other than document_drafting are not covered by the gateway rule. Only the AnA governed-write gate catches them, and model-governance.ts:25-30 lists them as known gaps. (5) /readyz does not reflect PQ: it reports ready while drafting is refused (tracked under AI-02). (6) The comments at effort.ts:156 and :207 are stale.
records.severityRationale: The safety half is fixed: production now fails closed instead of drafting on an unqualified model. The core Authoring AI-drafting journey still cannot work at all in the pilot's production environment until the founder approves the protocol and a PASS is recorded. CLAUDE.md Rule 2 and launch DoD row for PQ remain unmet.
records.humanTestingNote: On any NODE_ENV=production deployment (docker compose, beta compose, AWS staging), these are refused with 'No performance-qualified model is available for high-risk regulatory drafting in this environment.': AI drafting in the Authoring editor (generate, expand, rewrite section), section/IB/CSR generation, and AnA 'draft and save to Vault/editor'. Chat and review-style AnA turns still answer. Workaround for testers: exercise AI drafting on an `npm run dev` instance (NODE_ENV=development) with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set. A PQ-pending approved model then serves, and the ledger records pq_status 'pending'. Do not add a production bypass.
records.instructions:
1. Founder/system owner: review server/eval/pq/pq-protocol.json (PQ-DRAFT-001). In a reviewed commit on concept2cure-v2, set "status":"approved", "approvedBy" and "approvedOn". Confirm first that the doc-quality gold bank meets components.generation.criteria.minTasksPerDocType (AI-07).
2. Engineering, on a controlled machine with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (BAA in place): run `npm run pq:run -- --model claude-opus-4` (pinned claude-opus-5-5). Only if the verdict is PASS, rerun with `--record`. The record lands at docs/evidence/PQ/<date>/claude-opus-4.json.
3. Failing-first: in server/services/ai-governance/approved-models.ts:89, temporarily set the claude-opus-4 entry to pq {status:'passed', reference:'docs/evidence/PQ/does-not-exist.json'}. Run `npx vitest run server/services/ai-gateway/__tests__/high-risk-model-approval.test.ts` and confirm verifyPqClaim fails. Then set reference to the real record path from step 2 and confirm it passes. Commit only the real reference.
4. Extend server/eval/pq/run-pq.ts so the generation phase also runs the production drafting prompts: the prompt-registry versions used by server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts and server/services/authoring/section-generation-service.ts. Write each prompt id and version into the PqRecord. In server/eval/pq/pq-verdict.ts verifyPqClaim, refuse a 'passed' claim whose recorded prompt versions differ from the current ones, so a prompt change invalidates the pass. Prove it by bumping one prompt version in a scratch change and watching high-risk-model-approval.test.ts fail.
5. Inventory governed-text authors that call the gateway with a taskType other than 'document_drafting' (start from the known-gaps list in model-governance.ts:25-30 and `grep -rn "callerModule" server/services/cmc server/services/authoring`). Relabel each to taskType 'document_drafting', or route its persistence through the AnaToolExecutor.ts:507 gate.
6. Correct the stale comments at server/services/ai-gateway/effort.ts:156 and :207 to point at model-governance.ts selectionRefusal.
7. Do not add any environment variable or request field that skips 'pq-not-passed' in production. model-governance.ts:20-23 forbids it.
8. Land readiness reflecting PQ (AI-02 step 1) in the same push.
records.acceptance: a) Failing-first: on HEAD, selectionRefusal({id:'claude-opus-4',provider:'anthropic',model:'claude-opus-5-5'}, {taskType:'document_drafting'}, selectionGovernance(APPROVED_MODELS,{NODE_ENV:'production'})) returns 'pq-not-passed'. After step 3 it returns null, while every other entry still returns 'pq-not-passed'. b) high-risk-model-approval.test.ts fails for a 'passed' entry with a missing or mismatched record, and passes with the real one. c) pq-protocol.json has status 'approved' and a named approver and date. d) With NODE_ENV=production and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, an Authoring AI action through server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts returns a draft. Its ai ledger row (audit.ts) records model claude-opus-5-5 and pq_status 'passed'. The same request against a registry where the entry is 'pending' returns NO_PQ_QUALIFIED_MODEL. e) Changing a production drafting prompt version without a new PQ record makes high-risk-model-approval.test.ts fail.
records.dependencies: Founder approval of PQ-DRAFT-001; Anthropic API key and BAA (D6); AI-07 gold bank size; AI-02 readiness change

records.title: Production now gets an Anthropic drafting key, but /readyz and the deploy smoke ignore PQ, and Bedrock/Vertex are still undeployable
records.evidenceAtHead: CLOSED: terraform/stack/main.tf:125-128 creates the anthropic_api_key secret and :326 passes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the container. variables.tf:351-358 validates the sk-ant- prefix. main.tf:190-194 requires the placement approvals to name 'anthropic'. terraform/environments/production/main.tf:92 and staging/main.tf:95 pass it. .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml:517 and :541 refuse a deploy without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. server/startup/ana-readiness-state.ts:227-300 (recordHighRiskCoverage) sets 'no_high_risk_model' when no enabled model isApprovedForHighRisk, and inline-endpoints.ts:82-83 turns that into deps.ana 'down'. STILL OPEN: readiness uses isApprovedForHighRisk only (ana-readiness-state.ts:243-251). `grep -rln 'isQualifiedForHighRiskDrafting|pq-not-passed|NO_PQ_QUALIFIED_MODEL' server` finds no startup or readiness file. So in production, with every entry PQ 'pending', /readyz reports ana 'ok' and ready:true while the gateway refuses every document_drafting request (model-governance.ts:84-85). The deploy smoke (deploy-aws.yml:1059-1061) only checks .ready==true and so goes green with drafting dead. That repeats the 'second incident' that ana-readiness-state.ts:84-95 documents. package.json:452 has only @anthropic-ai/sdk (no bedrock-sdk or vertex-sdk). server/services/ai-gateway/providers/cloud-models.ts:49-87 still pins Bedrock/Vertex Opus to claude-opus-4-7 with contextWindow 200000 and 0.015/0.075 pricing, while approved-models.ts:217-248 keeps them approvedForHighRisk:true. `grep -rn inference_geo server` returns nothing.
records.fixedBy: c3e9e4930 (2026-10-01): terraform/stack/main.tf:125-128,190-194,326; terraform/stack/variables.tf:351-358; .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml:517,541. 25294ca56 (2026-09-25, merged after the audit): server/startup/ana-readiness-state.ts:227-300 'no_high_risk_model' readiness state
records.remaining: (1) /readyz and the startup invariant (server/lib/startup-invariants.ts:116-127) ask 'approved for high-risk', not 'may serve drafting in this environment'. In production they report ready while every draft is refused for lack of a PQ pass, and the deploy smoke goes green. (2) The deploy preflight does not check that at least one high-risk-approved, PQ-passed model exists. (3) Bedrock and Vertex cannot be deployed: no SDK dependency, stale Opus 4.7 pins, 200K context, old pricing, yet they stay approvedForHighRisk. (4) The first-party Anthropic API is used with no data-residency parameter.
records.severityRationale: The pilot-blocking part (no drafting-capable provider in the documented deploy) is fixed. What remains makes health checks misreport a dead drafting journey as ready, so operators and the deploy gate cannot see it. That must be fixed before pilot users rely on production. Bedrock/Vertex and residency are P2 for an FDA-only US pilot on first-party Anthropic.
records.humanTestingNote: On a NODE_ENV=production staging deployment, /readyz and the boot banner say AnA is ready, but Authoring AI drafting is refused (see AI-01). Testers should not take the readiness page as proof that drafting works. Check the drafting journey directly, or test it on an `npm run dev` instance.
records.instructions:
1. In server/startup/ana-readiness-state.ts recordHighRiskCoverage (:227-300), replace the local predicate `serves` (:250-251) for each task in HIGH_RISK_TASK_TYPES. The new check: `m.capabilities.includes(task) && selectionRefusal(m, { taskType: task }, selectionGovernance()) === null`, importing both from server/services/ai-gateway/model-governance.ts. Readiness and routing then share one rule, and that rule includes PQ in production.
2. Add a readiness state 'no_pq_qualified_model'. Its detail embeds NO_PQ_QUALIFIED_MODEL and lists each approved model with its pq status. Treat it as not serving in isAnaReadinessServing, as 'no_high_risk_model' is treated (the doctrine at ana-readiness-state.ts:84-95: a process that refuses every draft must not report ready). Note: once this lands, every NODE_ENV=production environment reports ready:false and the deploy-aws.yml smoke (:1059-1071) fails until AI-01 records a PQ pass. That is the true state. Sequence this with AI-01 and tell the founder before pushing, because it turns the staging deploy red.
3. Failing-first: add a case to the existing readiness tests (server/startup/__tests__ or wherever ana-readiness-state is tested). Use NODE_ENV=production and a gateway stub exposing claude-opus-4 enabled, with the real APPROVED_MODELS (all 'pending'). Assert 'no_pq_qualified_model'. Run it at HEAD and see it fail (HEAD returns 'ready'), then implement.
4. In .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml, next to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY preflight (:517-541), add a step: `npx tsx -e "import {APPROVED_MODELS,isQualifiedForHighRiskDrafting} from './server/services/ai-governance/approved-models.ts'; if(!APPROVED_MODELS.some(m=>m.provider==='anthropic'&&isQualifiedForHighRiskDrafting(m,true))){console.error('no PQ-passed Anthropic drafting model');process.exit(1)}"`. Show it fail at HEAD in a dry run before relying on it.
5. Bedrock/Vertex (P2): until @anthropic-ai/bedrock-sdk or vertex-sdk is a dependency and an IAM or inference-profile path exists in terraform/stack, set approvedForHighRisk:false on claude-opus-4-bedrock and claude-opus-4-vertex in approved-models.ts:217-248 (record the reason in highRiskBasis and lastReviewed). When they are adopted, bump the cloud-models.ts:49-87 pins, prices and contextWindow to the current Opus pin, and update the matching approved-models entries so the drift gate passes.
6. Residency (P2): confirm in the current Anthropic API documentation whether a data-residency/inference-geography request parameter exists. If it does, send it from the Anthropic provider when the tenant placement policy requires US-only processing, and record it in the ledger row.
records.acceptance: a) New readiness test: with NODE_ENV=production and only PQ-pending approved models enabled, evaluateAnaReadiness() returns 'no_pq_qualified_model' and /readyz returns ready:false with deps.ana 'down'. The test fails on HEAD. b) With NODE_ENV=development, or a PQ-passed entry, the same setup returns 'ready'. c) The deploy preflight step exits 1 on HEAD's registry and 0 once an Anthropic entry is PQ-passed. d) The drift test (approved-models drift gate) still passes after the Bedrock/Vertex change.
records.dependencies: AI-01 (a PQ pass is what turns readiness back to ready); founder awareness that staging goes not-ready until then

records.title: AnA run_python_script now runs only in the hardened container and refuses when that is not enabled
records.evidenceAtHead: workers/artifact-compute/python-script-runtime.py was deleted in 930fe7b4c (`git ls-tree` shows it at 92ccdba1, absent at HEAD). No remaining Python runtime calls exec/eval/compile (`grep -n 'exec\|eval\|compile(' workers/artifact-compute/*.py` finds nothing). server/services/compute/scriptWorker.ts:10-15 now runs only the fixed docx-insert runtime. The handler server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts:7711-7771 returns {available:false} unless getContainerExecConfig().enabled (ANA_ENABLE_CONTAINER_EXEC==='true'). It runs the code only via containerExec.runInContainer with script 'exec python3 /work/__script.py'. server/services/compute/containerExec.ts:75-86 builds `--network none` (unless ANA_CONTAINER_ALLOW_NETWORK==='true'), `--cap-drop ALL`, `--security-opt no-new-privileges`, `--read-only` and `--user`. Outputs are persisted to a per-organization scratch dir (AnaToolExecutor.ts:7689-7709). No deploy config enables container exec or mounts docker.sock (grep of docker-compose*.yml, Dockerfile.optimized, terraform: none), so on ECS the tool fails closed. Command run: `npx vitest run server/services/ana/__tests__/run-python-script-container.test.ts` gave 3/3 passed, including 'does not run anywhere when container execution is not enabled'. Non-blocking note: stale comments still describe the deleted host runtime at server/services/ana/legacy-import-tool-defs.ts:178-189 and server/services/compute/sandboxEnv.ts:6.
records.severityRationale: Model-written code no longer executes on the application host. The container path has no network by default, all capabilities dropped and a read-only root, and it is disabled in every deploy configuration.
records.humanTestingNote: Expected behaviour, not a defect: on deployments without ANA_ENABLE_CONTAINER_EXEC=true and Docker (all staging and production configs), AnA reports that run_python_script is not available, runs nothing, and suggests the structured tools instead.

Submission Twin is still reachable from the medtech/diagnostics nav and shows a readiness number seeded with a made-up 50 and model-graded evidence support. records.humanTestingNote: Submission Twin (device and diagnostics segments, 'Submit & file' > Submission Twin) shows a readiness score near 50, minus penalties, for a package with no readiness snapshot, and ranks claims by model-assigned confidence. Testers should log any number there as unverified and use Submission Center / Submission Readiness for readiness. Shadow Review gate scores now come from finding severities (fixed). The other affected endpoints have no UI caller, so testers will not see them.
records.instructions:
1. Submission Twin readiness. In server/services/submission-twin-service.ts:897, replace `readinessSnap?.readinessPercent ?? 50` with an explicit no-snapshot branch. It returns readinessScore null, fragilityScore computed as now, and reason 'no_readiness_snapshot'. Type readinessScore as `number | null` in the return type (~:775-780). In client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/SubmissionTwin.tsx (interface at :33, memo text at :175-195), render an honest empty state ('No readiness snapshot for this package; run Submission Readiness first') when the score is null. Failing-first: add a server unit test (no c2cReadinessSnapshots row, readinessScore must be null) and a case in client/src/concept2cure/v2/__tests__/submissionTwin.test.tsx. Run both at HEAD and see them fail (HEAD returns 50).
2. Submission Twin claim figures. Remove 'Assign a confidence score (0-1)' from the prompt at submission-twin-service.ts:1159, and relevanceScore from :1193. Compute support deterministically: an assessment is 'direct' only if its evidenceText occurs verbatim in the retrieved document context (reuse the span check in server/services/clinical-regulatory-evidence/lineage-gate.ts); otherwise 'unsupported'. Order claims by section and position instead of confidence at :280. Keep the existing column, write null, and do not drop it (Rule 1).
3. Sentence traceability. In server/services/sentenceTraceabilityService.ts:579-580, ignore mapping.needsReview. Set needsReview = claimType in {statistical, safety, efficacy} OR no source whose excerpt occurs verbatim in that source's text. Set isSupported only when such a verbatim excerpt exists with linkType 'supports'. Remove the needsReview instruction at :499-501. Failing-first: a unit test where the model mock returns needsReview:false for a statistical sentence with no verbatim excerpt must yield needsReview:true. It fails at HEAD.
4. Drafting routes (server/api/drafting/routes.ts; mount at server/api/gcc/index.ts:31). No client caller, and the tables are not in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES. Unmount the router and delete the file. The commit message must name the canonical replacement: Authoring AI drafting via server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts and AnA drafting via server/services/ana/AnaDocumentDraftingService.ts. Run the CLAUDE.md working-agreement history search and quote its result. If unmount is refused, at minimum: drop citations whose sourceId matches no retrieved chunk, take page only from matchingChunk.page_number (:432), and remove the 0.5 and 0.8 confidence defaults (:244, :592).
5. ana-cortex (server/routes/ana-cortex.ts:33-50; mount at bootstrap/register-inline-routes.ts:137-139; no client caller). Remove the numeric fields (regulatory_readiness_score, projected_delay_days, total_financial_impact, compliance_score, confidence_score) from both JSON shapes and from the response. The deterministic replacement for readiness is POST /api/submission-readiness/assess (server/routes/submission-readiness.ts:20, engine server/services/regulatory/submission-readiness.ts). Alternatively, unmount the router, naming that replacement.
6. Snowglobe (server/routes/snowglobe.ts:270-323). Remove 'score' and 'confidence' from the prompt shape. Compute each engine's score from its findings' severities with a pure function, as 0a366dc8b did for the artifact score. Add a test that a model-returned score is ignored.
7. csr-builder safety signals (server/services/csr-builder.ts:772-840; route server/routes/csr-builder-routes.ts:281-300; no client caller). Delete the endpoint and function. The replacement for the signal outcome is the data-backed /api/regulatory-programs/:id/safety-signals, consumed by client/src/concept2cure/mdx/surfaces/cer/SignalsTab.tsx. Name it in the commit.
8. indCopilot (server/services/indCopilot.js:624, :981, :1168-1204). Remove the model 'score' and 'completeness_score' fields and the `passed: score >= 70` rule. Return issues only, with passed=null ('not determined by a model'). Update server/services/__tests__/ind-copilot-compliance-check.test.ts so it fails first on the old behaviour.
9. Label as 'model-assessed' or drop the display-only figures at server/services/predictiveSectionService.ts:199 and server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts:1677.
10. Add scripts/ci/check-model-figure.mjs plus npm scripts `ci:model-figure` and `ci:model-figure:selftest`, and wire them into .husky/pre-push and the CI workflow. Scan server/**/*.{ts,js} string literals and server/services/ai-gateway/prompts/**/*.md for JSON-shape requests of numeric figures. Pattern: /"?(\w*(score|confidence|likelihood|probability|percent|count|days|impact)\w*)"?\s*:\s*(number|<number>|<integer[^>]*>|0(\.0)?-1(\.0)?|\d+-\d+)/i. Keep scripts/ci/model-figure-baseline.json where every entry has a written reason. The selftest must show the gate failing on a fixture copied from prompts/shadow-review/v1.0.md (rtfRiskScore) and on the HEAD csr-builder prompt before step 7 removes it.
records.acceptance: a) `npm run ci:model-figure:selftest` exits non-zero on the v1.0 shadow-review fixture and the csr-builder prompt fixture, and `npm run ci:model-figure` passes on the branch after fixes with a baseline whose every entry carries a reason. b) GET /api/submission-twin/readiness/:pkg for a package with no readiness snapshot returns readinessScore null (test fails on HEAD), and SubmissionTwin.tsx renders the empty state. c) Traceability test: a model mock answering needsReview:false for an unsupported statistical sentence yields needsReview:true. d) Snowglobe test: a model-returned score of 99 is not stored, and the engine score equals the severity-derived value. e) /api/gcc/drafting and /api/csr-builder/safety-signals return 404, and the commit messages name the replacement paths. f) No response from ana-cortex, snowglobe or indCopilot contains a model-produced numeric score.
records.dependencies: None blocking; step 5 references the Submission Readiness engine; coordinate step 4 deletion with the Authoring lane per the CLAUDE.md deletion rule
